detailed_descriptions.en: Follow Beebz and her crew on a journey of self-discovery as they travel the vast oceans of Ragnar's Rock in this vast platforming adventure! Navigate the open seas and explore each distant structure, uncovering every hidden nook and cranny with a diverse, expressive move-set. Beat challenges or find hidden chests to collect talismans along the way that modify your abilities and allow you to express yourself through your schmovement. You can even switch up your drip with a plethora of discoverable outfits! And never forget, you're not alone in this journey! Compete with other players for speedrunning times by challenging their ghosts, or tag a wall and share your message with the entire world! Are you ready to conquer this kingdom and expose all of its mysterious secrets? Or will Beebz be crushed by what awaits her? Only one way to find out! FEATURES A deeply expressive platforming move-set. Express yourself through your schmovement and get lost in the flow! A seamless, open ocean to explore at blazing speeds! Chill out with your crew and buy new items of interest at your mobile hub! Discover hidden secrets and unravel the world’s mysteries! Place your own checkpoints wherever you want and return to them any time you meet your untimely demise! Collect unique talismans and modify your move-set with paragliders, hookshots, bubbles and more! Change up your appearance with head gear, outfits and hair dyes; there’s no shortage of drip! Race other players and compete for the best completion times, may the best runner win! Create and share graffiti that will appear in other player’s worlds! Extra game modes like NG+ and Randomizer where rewards, enemies and even the weather are randomized! FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Do you need to play Demon Turf before playing Demon Tides? You can hop right into Demon Tides without ever having played Demon Turf before! There’s plenty of easter eggs for existing fans, but we’ve designed the narrative for new players to jump right in! What does “Expressive” platforming mean, exactly? Simply put, it’s a platformer where every solution is the right one! We want you to express yourself through the game’s movement, and to do that we’ve created a highly customisable move-set with nearly unlimited combinational depth. The further you get into the game, and the more comfortable you get with the movement, the more unique your gameplay will become! What’s Fabraz done before Demon Tides? We’re most well known for the 3D Platformer Demon Turf and 2D Platformer Slime-san! But we’re also behind lesser known titles such as Cannon Crasha, Planet Diver and even published Skellboy and SpiritSphere DX! Wait, are you also behind Bubsy 4D? We sure are, wild huh? We've teamed up with Atari to finally give that bobcat the love he always deserved!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Follow Beebz and her crew on a journey of self-discovery as they travel the vast oceans of Ragnar's Rock in this vast platforming adventure!

Navigate the open seas and explore each distant structure, uncovering every hidden nook and cranny with a diverse, expressive move-set. Beat challenges or find hidden chests to collect talismans along the way that modify your abilities and allow you to express yourself through your schmovement. You can even switch up your drip with a plethora of discoverable outfits!

And never forget, you're not alone in this journey! Compete with other players for speedrunning times by challenging their ghosts, or tag a wall and share your message with the entire world!

Are you ready to conquer this kingdom and expose all of its mysterious secrets? Or will Beebz be crushed by what awaits her? Only one way to find out!


FEATURES

  • A deeply expressive platforming move-set. Express yourself through your schmovement and get lost in the flow!

  • A seamless, open ocean to explore at blazing speeds!

  • Chill out with your crew and buy new items of interest at your mobile hub!

  • Discover hidden secrets and unravel the world’s mysteries!

  • Place your own checkpoints wherever you want and return to them any time you meet your untimely demise!

  • Collect unique talismans and modify your move-set with paragliders, hookshots, bubbles and more!

  • Change up your appearance with head gear, outfits and hair dyes; there’s no shortage of drip!

  • Race other players and compete for the best completion times, may the best runner win!

  • Create and share graffiti that will appear in other player’s worlds!

  • Extra game modes like NG+ and Randomizer where rewards, enemies and even the weather are randomized!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Do you need to play Demon Turf before playing Demon Tides?

You can hop right into Demon Tides without ever having played Demon Turf before! There’s plenty of easter eggs for existing fans, but we’ve designed the narrative for new players to jump right in!

What does “Expressive” platforming mean, exactly?

Simply put, it’s a platformer where every solution is the right one! We want you to express yourself through the game’s movement, and to do that we’ve created a highly customisable move-set with nearly unlimited combinational depth. The further you get into the game, and the more comfortable you get with the movement, the more unique your gameplay will become!

What’s Fabraz done before Demon Tides?

We’re most well known for the 3D Platformer Demon Turf and 2D Platformer Slime-san! But we’re also behind lesser known titles such as Cannon Crasha, Planet Diver and even published Skellboy and SpiritSphere DX!

Wait, are you also behind Bubsy 4D?

We sure are, wild huh? We've teamed up with Atari to finally give that bobcat the love he always deserved!
detailed_descriptions_html.ja:
「ビーブズ」とクルーの仲間たちとともに、「ラグナーロック」の広大な海へ自分探しの旅へ出発！

はるか先まで広がるオープンワールドの海。彼方にそびえる建造物を巡り、世界を隅々まで探検するには、躍動感あふれるムーブセットの数々が欠かせない。チャレンジをクリアしたり、隠された宝箱を見つけたりしていけば、アビリティを変化させるタリスマンが手に入る。さらに、この世界のあちこちにはオシャレな衣装が眠っている。お気に入りの着こなしで、ジブン流のスタイリッシュなアクションをバッチリ決めよう！

そして忘れないで。これは君一人の旅じゃない！ 他プレイヤーのゴーストとタイムを競うスピードランや、他プレイヤーの世界にも反映されるラクガキで、世界中にメッセージを届けよう！

この王国を制覇、完走して、その秘密を暴くことができるか？ それともビーブズは待ち受ける困難の前に倒れてしまうのか？結末はその目で確かめよう！

ゲームの特長

  • 躍動感あふれるムーブセットとジブン流のスタイリッシュなアクションでノリノリに！

  • シームレスに広がるオープンワールドの海。電光石火の速さで駆け抜けよう！

  • 移動式の拠点ではクルーの皆とチルしたり、気になるアイテムを買ったりできる！

  • 隠された秘密を見つけ出し、この世界の謎を解き明かせ！

  • チェックポイントを置いておけば、うっかり力尽きてしまってもそこから復帰が可能！

  • パラグライダーやフックショット、バブルなど、集めたタリスマンで自分好みのムーブセットを作ろう！

  • ヘッドギア、衣装、ヘアカラーなどカスタマイズは豊富。バチバチにキマるコーデがきっと見つかる！

  • 他プレイヤーと競争し、クリアタイムを競い合え！ 最速の称号は誰の手に！

  • ラクガキを描いて共有すると、他のプレイヤーの世界にも現れる！

よくある質問

『Demon Tides』の前に『Demon Turf』をプレイした方がいい？

『Demon Turf』を一度もプレイしていないプレイヤーでも『Demon Tides』を満喫できます！ ファンへ向けたクスッと笑える隠し要素もたくさんありますが、初めてのプレイヤーも気軽にこの世界へ飛び込めるようになっています！

「ジブン流のスタイリッシュアクション」って何？

一言で言えば、「どんな攻略法も正解」ということです！ アクションを通じて自分らしさを出せるよう、無限に近い組み合わせができる自由なムーブセットを用意しました。ゲームを進め、操作に慣れれば慣れるほど、あなただけのユニークなプレイスタイルが生まれるはずです！

『Demon Tides』以前のFabrazの作品は？

3Dプラットフォーマー『Demon Turf』や、2Dプラットフォーマー『Slime-san』などが知られています！ 一方で『Cannon Crasha』や『Planet Diver』などの比較的知られていないタイトルの制作や、『Skellboy』と『SpiritSphere DX』という作品のパブリッシングも手掛けました！

待って、あの『Bubsy 4D (やまねこバブジー4D)』もFabrazの作品なの!?

その通り！ 驚きましたか？ Atariとタッグを組んであのバブジーを復活させたのは、何を隠そう私たちなんです！
